recipes.name: Whimsical Parfait inspired by Darker than Black
ingredients: 2 tsp vanilla extract (or 2 vanilla pods, scraped & seeded)
instructions: For the Crème Anglaise
Combine the whole milk and heavy cream in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. - 15 ml whole milk - 12 ml heavy cream
In a mixing bowl, whisk together egg yolks and sugar until pale and smooth. - 6 large egg yolks - 7 oz sugar
Slowly pour the hot milk mixture into the egg mixture, whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Pour the mixture back into the saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it reaches 180°F. Do not let it boil.
Remove from heat and divide the crème anglaise into four containers for different ice cream flavors. - For the Crème Anglaise
For the Ice Cream Flavors
Chocolate Ice Cream: Stir in cocoa powder and into one container. - 1 oz cocoa powder - 1 tsp salt - For the Crème Anglaise
Vanilla Ice Cream: Add vanilla extract and a pinch of salt into another container. - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1 tsp salt - For the Crème Anglaise
Matcha Ice Cream: Stir matcha powder and sugar into the third container. - 1 tbsp sugar - 1 tbsp matcha powder - For the Crème Anglaise
Combine strawberries with Crème Anglaise blend and strain. Stir the strawberry concentrate into the final container. - 10 oz strawberries hulled - For the Crème Anglaise
Churn each ice cream flavor in an ice cream machine until thickened, about 20-25 minutes. Transfer to containers and freeze for 2-4 hours until firm. - For the Ice Cream Flavors:
For the Hot Fudge Sauce
Combine sugar, cocoa powder, water, glucose syrup, and salt in a saucepan. - 300 g sugar - 150 g cocoa powder - 240 ml water - 100 g glucose syrup - pinch of salt
Heat over medium until smooth and glossy, stirring constantly.
Transfer to a squeeze bottle and set aside. - For the Hot Fudge Sauce
For the Chocolate Choux Pastry
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Bring water, butter, sugar, and salt to a boil in a large saucepan. - 500 g water - 225 g unsalted butter cubed - 1 ½ tbsp sugar - 1 tsp salt
Remove from heat and sift in bread flour and cocoa powder until smooth - 200 g bread flour - 50 g cocoa powder
Return to medium heat and cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until the dough pulls away from the sides of the pan.
Remove from heat, let cool slightly, then add eggs one at a time, stirring until smooth and glossy. - 4 ½ large eggs
Pipe small mounds onto a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes until puffed and set.
For the Pastry Cream
Heat milk with sugar and salt in a saucepan until it simmers. - 600 g whole milk - 75 g sugar divided - 1 tsp salt
Combine milk, corn starch, and sugar to create a corn starch slurry. - 75 ml milk - 60 g cornstarch - 25 g sugar
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and sugar. - 4 large eggs - 100 g sugar

Slowly temper the hot milk mixture into the egg mixture, add vanilla pods and salt, and return everything to the saucepan. - For the Milk Mixture - For the Egg Mixture - 2 tsp vanilla extract (or 2 vanilla pods scraped & seeded) - 1 tsp salt
Add corn starch slurry, then cook until thickened, whisking constantly. - For the Cornstarch Slurry
Remove from heat, whisk in butter, then chill. - 70 g unsalted butter cubed
For the Mochi
Combine Shiratamako and water in a bowl, kneading into a smooth dough. - 100 g Shiratamako (sweet rice flour) - 90 g water
Roll into small balls and boil for 3-5 minutes until they float.
Transfer to an ice bath, then drain and set aside.
For the Waffle Cones
Preheat waffle cone press.
Mix sugar and egg until smooth, then add flour, vanilla, melted butter, and milk. - 100 g sugar - 1 large egg - 100 g all purpose flour - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 50 g melted butter - 90 g milk
Drop batter into the center of the waffle press and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden. - For the Waffle Cones
Shape into cones while warm and let cool.
For the Assembly
Start with a layer of hot fudge sauce at the base of a tall glass. - For the Hot Fudge Sauce
Add crushed waffle cones, pastry cream, and more fudge sauce. - For the Waffle Cones - For the Pastry Cream - For the Hot Fudge Sauce
Layer the mochi on top. - For the Mochi
Alternate scoops of chocolate, vanilla, matcha, and strawberry ice cream. - For the Chocolate Flavor - For the Vanilla Flavor - For the Matcha Flavor - For the Strawberry Flavor
Top with a cream puff and a whole waffle cone. - For the Choux Pastry (Cream Puffs): - For the Waffle Cones
